q: Consider the following statements regarding the PM Vishwakarma Scheme: 1. It was launched in 2023. 2. It provides end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades. 3. It has a financial outlay of ₹13,000 crore for five years. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: The PM Vishwakarma Scheme was launched in 2023, covers artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades, and has a financial outlay of ₹13,000 crore for FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28.

q: Which of the following correctly represents the three pillars of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme?
explanation: The three pillars of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme are Samman (Respect), Samarthya (Capability) and Samriddhi (Prosperity).

q: Under the PM Vishwakarma Scheme, the toolkit incentive is available up to:
explanation: The scheme provides a toolkit incentive of up to ₹15,000 to eligible artisans and craftspeople.

q: The PM Vishwakarma Scheme provides collateral-free loans up to what amount at an interest rate of 5%, according to the supplied current-affairs material?
explanation: The scheme provides collateral-free loans of up to ₹3 lakh at a 5% interest rate.

q: The Bharat Vann green initiative is primarily associated with which of the following?
explanation: Bharat Vann is an urban afforestation initiative undertaken in collaboration with the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC).

q: The Bharat Vann initiative mentioned in the current-affairs material was inaugurated at which location?
explanation: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman inaugurated Bharat Vann at Lodhi Colony Park in Central Delhi.

q: According to the supplied current-affairs material, the mandatory wage ceiling under EPFO was increased from ₹15,000 to:
explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the proposal to raise the mandatory wage ceiling under EPFO from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month.

q: According to the supplied current-affairs material, Moody's revised India's GDP growth forecast for the current fiscal year to:
explanation: Moody's revised its India GDP growth forecast upward from 6% to 7%, citing the resilience of the Indian economy amid uncertainties.

q: Japan's central bank raised its key interest rate from 1% to what level, according to the supplied material?
explanation: Japan's key interest rate was raised to 1.25%, described in the supplied material as the highest borrowing cost since 1995.

q: Sohar Port, which has emerged as a strategic alternative gateway for Indian cargo destined for GCC countries, is located in:
explanation: Sohar Port is located in Oman. It is described as a modern deep-sea commercial port and integrated industrial free zone.

q: Which country was proposed as the European Union's first-ever associate member?
explanation: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed Canada as the EU's first-ever associate member as part of an 'Alliance for the Future' initiative.

q: According to the supplied material, Russian crude accounted for approximately what share of India's crude oil imports in July 2026?
explanation: The supplied material states that Russian crude accounted for over 51% of India's crude oil imports in July 2026.

q: Which of the following was NOT mentioned as a measure being considered by India to strengthen economic security amid sanctions?
options: Completely stopping all crude oil imports
explanation: The material mentions measures such as a Sanctions War Room, strategic petroleum reserves, import diversification, de-dollarization efforts and maritime insurance initiatives. Complete cessation of crude imports was not mentioned.

q: The changing economic relationship between India and Bhutan is described as moving beyond which traditional framework?
explanation: The supplied material states that Bhutan's economic transformation is creating new avenues for cooperation beyond the traditional development-assistance framework.

q: Which exoplanet was described as the youngest known planet ever detected?
explanation: Elias 2-24 b was described as the youngest known planet ever detected, with an estimated age of less than one million years.

q: Elias 2-24 b is described as what type of astronomical object?
explanation: The supplied material describes Elias 2-24 b as a nascent gas-giant exoplanet.

q: The confirmation of Elias 2-24 b used NASA-funded archival data from which observatory?
explanation: An international team used NASA-funded archival data from the W. M. Keck Observatory to confirm Elias 2-24 b.

q: The 5th edition of SEMICON India 2026 was inaugurated at:
explanation: The 5th edition of SEMICON India 2026 was inaugurated at Yashobhoomi (IICC) in New Delhi.

q: SEMICON India primarily focuses on which sector?
explanation: SEMICON India is described as India's flagship international semiconductor conference and exhibition, connecting the global microelectronics industry.

q: The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 were scheduled to commence on:
explanation: According to the supplied current-affairs material, the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 were scheduled to commence on September 19, 2026.

q: Who were named India's flag-bearers for the opening ceremony of the 2026 Asian Games?
options: Manu Bhaker and Tajinderpal Singh Toor
Sift Kaur Samra and Harmanpreet Singh
explanation: Shooter Manu Bhaker and shot putter Tajinderpal Singh Toor were named India's flag-bearers for the opening ceremony in Nagoya.

q: According to the supplied material, which sport has historically contributed the highest number of medals for India at the Asian Games?
explanation: Athletics has historically been India's most successful sport at the Asian Games, contributing 283 medals according to the supplied material.

q: India's first farm-level soil carbon payments mentioned in the current-affairs material were associated with farmers in:
explanation: More than 2,550 small farmers in Punjab and Haryana received more than ₹2.9 crore through Direct Benefit Transfer for verified regenerative farming practices.

q: The soil carbon payments mentioned in the current-affairs material were made through which mechanism?
explanation: The payments were made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to farmers participating in verified regenerative farming practices.

q: The report titled 'Forests for food: Nourishing people, sustaining the planet' was published by:
options: FAO in collaboration with the Landscape Alliance (CIFOR-ICRAF)
explanation: The report was published by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in collaboration with the Landscape Alliance (CIFOR-ICRAF).

q: The twin flower fields introduced in Ladakh are located at approximately what elevation?
explanation: The twin flower fields were introduced in Leh District at a height of approximately 10,600 feet to promote commercial floriculture.

q: The expansion of the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) includes which of the following?
options: Surgical products, medical consumables and healthcare devices
explanation: The government is expanding PMBJP beyond affordable medicines to include surgical products, medical consumables and healthcare devices.

q: According to the supplied material, generic medicines under PMBJP are generally available at prices approximately how much lower than branded medicines?
explanation: The supplied material states that PMBJP offers quality-assured generic medicines generally 50–80% cheaper than branded medicines.

q: The government aims to establish how many Jan Aushadhi Kendras by March 2027?
explanation: The government aims to establish 25,000 Jan Aushadhi Kendras by March 2027.

q: Under the amended passport rules mentioned in the material, an ordinary passport issued to a child below 15 years will be valid for:
options: Five years or until attaining 18 years, whichever is earlier
Ten years or until attaining 18 years, whichever is earlier
explanation: For a child below 15 years, the amended rule provides validity of five years or until the child attains 18 years, whichever is earlier.

q: Which of the following systems were identified in the supplied material as areas through which unilateral sanctions could create vulnerabilities for India?
explanation: The material identifies vulnerabilities involving banking, SWIFT, the US dollar-based global financial system, shipping and maritime insurance.

q: According to the supplied material, more than what percentage of global maritime Protection and Indemnity (P&I) coverage is underwritten by London-based clubs?
explanation: The supplied material states that over 90% of global maritime P&I coverage is underwritten by London-based clubs.

q: Which Marathi film was selected as India's official representative for the 99th Academy Awards, according to the supplied material?
explanation: The Marathi thriller 'Gondhal', directed by Santosh Davakhar, was selected as India's official representative for the 99th Academy Awards.

q: The NHAI's OneTag FASTag portability service allows users to:
options: Change the FASTag issuer bank without replacing the existing tag
Use one FASTag simultaneously on multiple vehicles
Convert FASTag into a toll-free pass
explanation: OneTag, introduced through the Rajmargyatra app, allows users to change their FASTag issuer bank without replacing the tag installed on the vehicle.

q: According to the supplied material, who became Asia's richest person?
explanation: The supplied material identifies Zhang Yiming, founder of ByteDance, as Asia's richest person, with an approximate net worth of $105 billion according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index cited in the material.

q: Five orphaned orangutans mentioned in the current-affairs material were rescued from:
options: Bichitrapur forest in Odisha's Balasore district
explanation: Five orphaned orangutans were rescued from Bichitrapur forest in Odisha's Balasore district and transferred to Nandankanan Zoo in Bhubaneswar.

q: The Odisha orangutan case highlighted concerns related to which international convention?
explanation: The case highlighted issues related to CITES, the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora, as well as wildlife trafficking.
